tools.description: Publish an event of a type this task declares emitting. `packet` is validated against that event's schema before publishing — an invalid packet comes back as a tool error to correct and retry. `dedupeKey`, when given, makes a repeated emit under the same key a no-op (emitIfNew semantics) — use it for anything that must not double-fire across retries.

tools.name: done
tools.description: Finish the run successfully with an optional result.

tools.name: fail
tools.description: Finish the run as failed, with a reason.
